name: Resistor Environment QA 22
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Equivalent EMF of series-connected cells

examples.input: Two cells of EMF E1 and E2 with internal resistances r1 and r2 are connected in series.  with their terminals arranged so that both EMFs aid each other (the positive terminal of one cell is connected to the negative terminal of the other). What is the equivalent EMF of this combination?
